meaning_en: Do we work on market {market} for you?
meaning_zh: 我们是否为你运营 {market} 市场？
meaning_zh-Hant: 我們是否為你運營 {market} 市場？

meaning_en: {by} declared market {market} on {at}. Until a person confirms it, nothing can be confirmed for {market}
meaning_zh: {by} 于 {at} 登记了市场 {market}。在本人确认之前，{market} 的任何内容都无法确认
meaning_zh-Hant: {by} 於 {at} 登記了市場 {market}。在本人確認之前，{market} 的任何內容都無法確認

meaning_en: {market} stays undeclared and nothing is written for it; the agent asks which markets are right
meaning_zh: {market} 保持未登记，不会为它写入任何内容；助手会再问哪些市场是对的
meaning_zh-Hant: {market} 保持未登記，不會為它寫入任何內容；助手會再問哪些市場是對的

meaning_en: {label} for {market}: is {value} right?
meaning_zh: {market} 的{label}：{value} 对吗？
meaning_zh-Hant: {market} 的{label}：{value} 對嗎？

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] = {value} waits for a person: {by} set it on {at} (source {source}). Nothing uses it until it is confirmed. It is used for: {why}
meaning_zh: {key} [{market}] = {value} 等待本人确认：{by} 于 {at} 设置（来源 {source}）。确认之前不会被使用。用途：{why}
meaning_zh-Hant: {key} [{market}] = {value} 等待本人確認：{by} 於 {at} 設置（來源 {source}）。確認之前不會被使用。用途：{why}

meaning_en: {key} stays pending and nothing uses it; the agent sets the right value or asks again
meaning_zh: {key} 保持待确认，不会被使用；助手会改成正确的值或再次询问
meaning_zh-Hant: {key} 保持待確認，不會被使用；助手會改成正確的值或再次詢問

meaning_en: {label} of {entity_type} {entity_id}: is {value} right?
meaning_zh: {entity_type} {entity_id} 的{label}：{value} 对吗？
meaning_zh-Hant: {entity_type} {entity_id} 的{label}：{value} 對嗎？

meaning_en: {entity_type} {entity_id} {key} = {value} waits for a person: {by} set it on {at} (source {source}). Until it is confirmed, {effective} stays in force. It is used for: {why}
meaning_zh: {entity_type} {entity_id} {key} = {value} 等待本人确认：{by} 于 {at} 设置（来源 {source}）。确认之前仍以 {effective} 为准。用途：{why}
meaning_zh-Hant: {entity_type} {entity_id} {key} = {value} 等待本人確認：{by} 於 {at} 設置（來源 {source}）。確認之前仍以 {effective} 為準。用途：{why}

meaning_en: {effective} stays in force; the agent withdraws the proposal or sets another value
meaning_zh: 仍以 {effective} 为准；助手会撤回提议或改设别的值
meaning_zh-Hant: 仍以 {effective} 為準；助手會撤回提議或改設別的值

meaning_en: Approve {kind} on {target_ref} ({market})?
meaning_zh: 批准对 {target_ref}（{market}）执行 {kind} 吗？
meaning_zh-Hant: 批准對 {target_ref}（{market}）執行 {kind} 嗎？

meaning_en: The skill pack proposed this on {created_at} from the data it read (basis {basis}). Nothing is sent until a person approves, and execute refuses it if that data moves. The rule says: {because}
meaning_zh: 系统于 {created_at} 根据读取的数据（依据 {basis}）提出此操作。本人批准前不会发送；数据若有变动，执行时会被拒绝。规则说明：{because}
meaning_zh-Hant: 系統於 {created_at} 根據讀取的數據（依據 {basis}）提出此操作。本人批准前不會發送；數據若有變動，執行時會被拒絕。規則說明：{because}

meaning_en: {kind} on {target_ref}: {expected}
meaning_zh: 对 {target_ref} 执行 {kind}：{expected}
meaning_zh-Hant: 對 {target_ref} 執行 {kind}：{expected}

meaning_en: Nothing is sent. The agent records the no with a reason code, and the next proposal run reads it
meaning_zh: 不会发送任何内容。助手会记录拒绝原因代码，下次提案时会参考
meaning_zh-Hant: 不會發送任何內容。助手會記錄拒絕原因代碼，下次提案時會參考

meaning_en: {id}: no gate, {word} cannot be a console verb word; confirm it at the terminal
meaning_zh: {id}：无法通过控制台确认，{word} 不能作为命令词；请在终端确认
meaning_zh-Hant: {id}：無法通過控制台確認，{word} 不能作為命令詞；請在終端確認

meaning_en: {id}: no gate, what it binds is {length} characters, more than the console holds; confirm it at the terminal
meaning_zh: {id}：无法通过控制台确认，绑定内容有 {length} 个字符，超出控制台上限；请在终端确认
meaning_zh-Hant: {id}：無法通過控制台確認，綁定內容有 {length} 個字符，超出控制台上限；請在終端確認

meaning_en: {id}: no gate, the console's call cannot name the market (not a plain word) and several are declared ({markets}); confirm it at the terminal with --market
meaning_zh: {id}：无法通过控制台确认，市场名不是控制台能传的单词，而已登记多个市场（{markets}）；请在终端用 --market 确认
meaning_zh-Hant: {id}：無法通過控制台確認，市場名不是控制台能傳的單詞，而已登記多個市場（{markets}）；請在終端用 --market 確認

meaning_en: {id}: no gate yet, market {market} is not confirmed; answer its market declaration first
meaning_zh: {id}：暂时无法通过控制台确认，市场 {market} 尚未确认；请先确认市场登记
meaning_zh-Hant: {id}：暫時無法通過控制台確認，市場 {market} 尚未確認；請先確認市場登記

meaning_en: {id}: no gate, the confirm would be refused: {reason}
meaning_zh: {id}：无法通过控制台确认，确认会被拒绝：{reason}
meaning_zh-Hant: {id}：無法通過控制台確認，確認會被拒絕：{reason}

meaning_en: write recommend.because in each of the {count} ask(s) before ask.py add; the console refuses an ask without it
meaning_zh: 在 ask.py add 之前，请为这 {count} 个问题逐一写上 recommend.because；缺少它控制台会拒收
meaning_zh-Hant: 在 ask.py add 之前，請為這 {count} 個問題逐一寫上 recommend.because；缺少它控制台會拒收

meaning_en: asks waiting on a person: {facts} fact(s), {decisions} decision(s), {queue} queue item(s)
meaning_zh: 等待本人处理的问题：事实 {facts} 项，决定 {decisions} 项，队列操作 {queue} 项
meaning_zh-Hant: 等待本人處理的問題：事實 {facts} 項，決定 {decisions} 項，隊列操作 {queue} 項

meaning_en: asks waiting on a person: {facts} fact(s), {files} file(s), {decisions} decision(s), {queue} queue item(s)
meaning_zh: 等待本人处理的问题：事实 {facts} 项，客户文件 {files} 个，决定 {decisions} 项，队列操作 {queue} 项
meaning_zh-Hant: 等待本人處理的問題：事實 {facts} 項，客戶文件 {files} 個，決定 {decisions} 項，隊列操作 {queue} 項

meaning_en: What the agent read from {name}: {rows} map row(s) and {values} value(s). Confirm them together?
meaning_zh: 从 {name} 读出的内容：映射 {rows} 行、数值 {values} 项。一起确认吗？
meaning_zh-Hant: 從 {name} 讀出的內容：映射 {rows} 行、數值 {values} 項。一起確認嗎？

meaning_en: The agent mapped {name} (version {version}) and read {values} value(s) from its cells. One yes confirms all of it; nothing from this version is used before that
meaning_zh: agent 映射了 {name}（版本 {version}），并从单元格读出 {values} 项数值。一次确认全部生效；确认前，这个版本的内容都不使用
meaning_zh-Hant: agent 映射了 {name}（版本 {version}），並從單元格讀出 {values} 項數值。一次確認全部生效；確認前，這個版本的內容都不使用

meaning_en: Nothing from this version is used; the agent corrects the map or the values and stages the file again
meaning_zh: 这个版本的内容都不使用；agent 改正映射或数值后重新提交
meaning_zh-Hant: 這個版本的內容都不使用；agent 改正映射或數值後重新提交
